Hello Friends, First it is a great pleasure to meet you and join you on your journey to a healthier you. I am excited to be a part of your journey.    This portal will help not only you track every part of your daily intake of food, activity, water, sleep, BM's, menstrual cycles, but it helps me on my end guide you on a daily basis to see where you are at as far as weight, what foods you are eating and I can send you a message to change things up if needed to help you gain the optimal weight loss during your program.  I check this portal a few times per day so please chart and send your messages! This is our form of communication.   I am your daily contact, motivation and here to help you get that weight off. So please track every day so we can utilize this great program and software to get you were you want to be!  If you ever have questions, you know where to find me!
If you have questions about Red Light Therapy or Bio Identical Hormone Replacement Therapy or TRT these also will help aid in Weight Loss. Always reach out!
Have a great day!  Kelly Williams ~ Appel  Weight Loss
The wait is over. Welcome to our most effective weight loss program yet.

Begin with Wellness Weight Loss welcomes you to your journey to shed unwanted pounds to become the best, healthiest possible version of yourself!  Congratulations on taking this step toward wellness for you!!  Nobody deserves it more!!  
We look forward to traveling with you on this journey! If you have questions please reach out to us on the tracker message system and we will be happy to give you the guidance you need to succeed!
I can't wait to hear the story of your success and see your before and after photos!  
Cheers to starting something new! Be sure to check our Begin With Wellness Weight Loss Quick Start Guide Video!
 
Dr. Julie McLaughlin

Welcome to your online support portal!  Our goal is to support and encourage you in loosing your goal weight and improving your health.
We want to help you manage your daily diet and trouble-shoot any problems you may have!

Everyday, please log your plan adherence grade, weight, water and food intake. Other measurements are optional. 
Ballantyne Weight Loss Center is not only here to help you lose the weight, but to keep it off for good!

ChiroThin Weight Loss Program is the premier program for sustainable weight loss. With its clinically proven formula, you can lose up to 30 pounds in just 6 weeks while still enjoying your favorite foods. ChiroThin features a customized nutritional plan with meal replacement shakes and supplements designed to give you the energy and nutrition you need to feel your best. Our trained professionals will be with you every step of the way to coach and encourage you as you work towards achieving your weight loss goals. If you’re ready to make a lasting change in your lifestyle, start today with ChiroThin Weight Loss Program!

Providing care for your Entire Family!
Here at Groskopp Chiropractic we provide quality chiropractic care and a Weight loss program to Brillion, and the surrounding areas! 
We care deeply about our community and enjoy working with different companies, organizations, schools, and our local sports teams.
We welcome the opportunity to help you, your family and friends. We want to see each and everyone of you heal and reach all your health goals!  Everyone deserves to be healthy and express their full potential from the time they are born through their last breath of life. This includes you.

Dr. Marla's ChiroWellness Spa is owned and operated by Dr. Marla Hamilton, DC, LE, a licensed chiropractor, esthetician and certified body contouring specialist. Her goal is to help her patients improve their overall well-being and live happier lives. She provides a comprehensive set of services that span from chiropractic care, body sculpting, skin rejuvenation, massage therapy, body treatments, weight loss and more. She is committed to taking care of you and providing the best patient care experience from day one and beyond. She looks forward to serving YOU!
